rasterization.coordinates: Explicit integer native target-image XY, implicit polygon closure; reject repeated vertices, degenerate or self-intersecting polygons.

refinement.description: Only explicitly selected visible-skin polygons may restore eligibility inside the original band. Glasses/lenses/frame/bridge envelopes plus safety margin and all unreviewed old-band pixels remain excluded. This is an AI development candidate without physical segmentation ground truth.

observations.annotation_preview_policy: Inspect polygon outlines on each unchanged native PNG before freezing. If candidate overlays show a defect, retain v1 and make a separately frozen revision. Do not tune for UV support or detector scores.

publication.old_baseline_gate: All12 selected targets must reproduce original mask pixels and contributor decomposition before any candidate publication.
publication.artifacts: Four new allowed/occluded/label PNG sets plus full37 compatible AI mask-review JSON, all in a new research directory.
publication.unchanged_comparators: Preserve other33 review rows exactly, and all original saved masks/atlases/geometry.
publication.failure_policy: Any preparation failure blocks the whole candidate batch. Source/input/plan/runtime drift clears all candidate records and only removes artifacts created by this run; foreign files and old outputs are preserved.

saved_asset_semantics: masks_modified=false refers to unchanged original saved masks; candidate files are new separately versioned artifacts. No inference or automatic external occluder segmentation.
